# Copilot Instructions for YBTMK Dashboard

This is a Django project for building a YBTMK Dashboard application.

## Project Setup Checklist

- [x] Create copilot-instructions.md file
- [x] Get Django project setup info
- [x] Scaffold Django project with manage.py, settings, and WSGI/ASGI
- [x] Customize project structure with templates and static files
- [x] Install required extensions (None required for Django)
- [x] Compile and verify project (migrations applied, system checks passed)
- [x] Update documentation with setup and usage instructions

## Development Notes

- Python version: 3.9+
- Framework: Django
- Database: SQLite (default)
- Virtual Environment: Python venv
